name: Persistent ARMv8 (PARMv8)
description: First formalisation of the persistency semantics of the ARMv8 architecture, layering a persist-order axiom (what survives a crash on non-volatile memory) on top of the ARMv8 consistency model. The persist dimension is orthogonal to ARMv8's read/write reordering; the crash-free behaviour coincides with ARMv8.

catSupport.note: A declarative persist-order axiom layered on the ARMv8 consistency model (aarch64.cat); per-execution, but no cat model covers the persistency dimension.
